discoveredDuring: Administration regression after Espresso page review; original B0 Bishkek-day test failed on the existing Asia/Bishkek regression database.

before.results: Original existing test missed a 19:30Z write-off belonging to the following Bishkek business day. Added matrix: UTC case passed; Asia/Bishkek and Asia/Shanghai cases failed. Combined baseline was 3 failed / 55 passed.

cause: Prisma Date query parameters are bound with a timezone while movement columns contain UTC timestamp values without a zone. Implicit comparisons can reinterpret stored times in the PostgreSQL session TimeZone.
change: Bind ISO date text explicitly as ::timestamp in seven comparisons across stockouts, slow movers and shrinkage. This matches the already established UTC timestamp storage contract and the loyalty correction. Functions optionally accept a transaction query client so the same report SQL can be tested under controlled DB sessions; callers retain the default Prisma client.
retained: Existing role/store/organization scope, inclusive range boundaries, pagination and grouping
Stockout crossing and later-movement reconstruction formulas
Slow-mover selection semantics and current on-hand values
Shrinkage quantities, grouping and source rows; no data migration or monetary computation change

tests.edges: Source movements 1ms before, exactly at the start, inside, exactly at the end and 1ms after. Three in-range write-offs total 3; two zero-stock crossings retained; only the actual idle product is returned. Last movement timestamps retain exact instants. Empty page 2 retains total 1.
tests.note: 54 is the number of real SQL report calls, not 54 distinct automated test cases.

checks.overlap: The same three date-binding cases appear in both suite selections; do not add the suite counts as distinct tests.

productionBuild.result: passed with current sources, types/lint and 125 static pages

delivery: Isolated test infrastructure and local playground branch only. No production data, main merge or deployment.
